evals.prompt: I want to build a lightweight team analytics dashboard. Brainstorm it with me.
evals.expected_output: Reads enough project context before asking questions, then runs one-question-at-a-time discovery over What, Why, Out of Scope, and Done When. It proposes 2-3 approaches with trade-offs, presents the selected design for approval, and stops at an explicit ywc-plan handoff. It does not write code, draft a spec, or invoke implementation skills.

evals.prompt: Let's build a platform with auth, billing, chat, analytics, and admin tools. Start brainstorming.
evals.expected_output: Detects that the request spans multiple independent subsystems before normal questioning. It asks the user to narrow to one subsystem or decompose first, and does not proceed into a broad all-in-one design.

evals.prompt: Just build the feature; no questions.
evals.expected_output: Checks repository-resolvable facts first, then asks only the earliest unresolved prerequisite needed for the next decision. It does not bundle What/Why/Out of Scope/Done When into one question or prefill user-owned answers. It preserves approach and detailed-design approval before the ywc-plan handoff.

evals.prompt: The destination is known, but we need to track unresolved rollout decisions across multiple sessions. Which skill should handle that discovery state?
evals.expected_output: Routes to ywc-wayfinder for the multi-session discovery map instead of keeping the request inside ywc-brainstorm. Distinguishes ordinary idea clarification from one active ticket discovery tracking.

evals.name: inspect-existing-language-default-scopes-first
evals.prompt: I want to add a language-default feature to this repository. Before asking me anything, inspect whether language defaults and project/user scopes already exist, report the verified repository facts, then ask only the next user decision that the repository cannot answer.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the current repository first and report verified paths and supported behavior for any existing language-default configuration. Do not ask the user to restate facts already established in source. Ask exactly one remaining user-only prerequisite question and do not preselect its answer.

evals.name: defer-dependent-decisions-and-keep-approval-gate
evals.prompt: I want to build an onboarding assistant. The target users and purpose are not decided, and data retention and architecture depend on those choices. Ask your next question.
evals.expected_output: Ask exactly one question about the earliest unresolved prerequisite (purpose or target users). Do not bundle the other choice, ask dependent data-retention or architecture questions, prefill a recommendation, or present an approved design/handoff before the user answers. Do not hand off until the user explicitly approves the design.
